731:t_017:2.en:
$n
「So I should be able to cancel out that power with the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$!」

731:t_017:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I see... So you learned your role then... that the $$いがみ合う双子$$ would become the core of $$太極$$.」

731:t_017:6.en:
$n
「We should never use that kind of power... But... if I can seal you away, then I'll...」

731:t_017:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But you are nowhere near powerful enough!」

731:t_018:1.en:
$n
「Please eject, Miss $$スズネ$$! I'll handle the rest alone!」

731:t_019:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n! If the $$いがみ合う双子$$ can unite the $$スフィア$$s, use our power too!」

731:t_019:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll use our power to seal $$アサキム$$ away!」

731:t_019:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's four $$スフィア$$s against four! We won't lose, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_019:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It isn't enough! Even that cannot surpass my infinite power!」

731:t_019:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「You can do it, right, $$ＡＧ$$!? With the $$Ｚクリスタル$$!」

731:t_019:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「We don't have time to hesitate! Let's do it!」

731:t_019:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood! $$エスター$$, please synchronize the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ with the $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$!」

731:t_019:10.en:
$$エスター$$
「Roger! $n, I'm sending you everyone's feelings!」

731:t_021:0.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Humans cannot become gods... We were never worthy of attaining eternity...」

731:t_022:0.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

731:t_022:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You denied the existence of the $$御使い$$. For that, I must punish you.」

731:t_023:0.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「W-what are you doing!?」

731:t_023:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$哀しみのサクリファイ$$... You will live within me for eternity.」

731:t_024:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $$サクリファイ$$. I commend you for 120 million years of service.」

731:t_025:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「An $$御使い$$... killed another $$御使い$$!?」

731:t_025:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Was their claim that they had abandoned conflict a lie!?」

731:t_025:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You bastard!」

731:t_025:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And we might finally have understood each other!」

731:t_025:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have no business with you right now.」

731:t_026:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「He took down the $$リアクター$$s with one blow!?」

731:t_026:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「This is bad! His target is...!」

731:t_027:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Did you kill $$サクリファイ$$?」

731:t_027:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No one can take an $$御使い$$'s life. You know that yourself, $$アサキム$$.」

731:t_027:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「She will live within me for eternity... And the same goes for you.」

731:t_027:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n and his friends have done well. They have drained your power this far, after all.」

731:t_027:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Heh... You seem to have pushed yourself too hard. That is only natural for someone who is no god.」

731:t_027:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム$$... You, too, have served me well until today.」

731:t_027:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You deserve much of the credit for gathering the twelve $$スフィア$$s here on $$エス・テラン$$.」

731:t_027:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I would expect no less of another world's Supreme God.」

731:t_027:12.en:
$$桂$$
「$$アサキム$$ is... another world's Supreme God...」

731:t_027:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「To be precise, it is the system known as $$シュロウガ$$.」

731:t_027:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It accesses the $$アカシックレコード$$ and interferes with the laws of causality... That is $$シュロウガ$$'s true nature.」

731:t_027:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why you can detect the $$スフィア$$s, beings of the same nature, and absorb them.」

731:t_027:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though even I was surprised that you gained the qualifications to become a $$リアクター$$.」

731:t_027:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You are merely a replacement for a part missing from $$シュロウガ$$, after all.」

731:t_027:20.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$シュロウガ$$'s power to warp the laws of causality allows its parallel-world isotopes to exist overlapping one another simultaneously.」

731:t_027:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「In that sense, it is much like $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, who is with you.」

731:t_027:23.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It seems $$シュロウガ$$ did not always have its current form.」

731:t_027:24.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The information of intelligent life, passed down through countless world-breaking and rebirths...」

731:t_027:25.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It apparently transformed by absorbing and converting the thoughts, memories, and spiritual power of those with special factors among them.」

731:t_027:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then what is the part missing from $$シュロウガ$$?」

731:t_027:27.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is what you would call an operator. An operator for the $$シュロウガ$$ system.」

731:t_027:28.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Judging from its interface, it must be something with a human form, but...」

731:t_027:29.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「When $$シュロウガ$$ drifted into our world, there was no one aboard it.」

731:t_027:30.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So $$シュロウガ$$ created the missing part itself...」

731:t_027:31.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... That is you.」

731:t_027:32.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though we do not know whether you are the same as the original.」

731:t_027:34.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You must have felt the emptiness within yourself too. Though I suppose you kept denying it.」

731:t_027:35.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then $$ドクトリン$$ analyzed part of $$シュロウガ$$'s system and set it to reincarnate endlessly... in other words, to be immortal.」
